name: palewire/cpi
what_it_holds: Python package (145 stars, MIT) with a /data directory bundling CPI series for inflation adjustment (US dollars any-year-to-any-year); pip-installable, docs at palewi.re/docs/cpi/.
why_useful: Turnkey CPI deflator library with data actually committed to the repo rather than fetched live each time, useful for point-in-time-safe inflation adjustment of any nominal series in the model (ADR, GBV) without hitting BLS API rate limits.
size_hint: small (CPI index only, not itemized subcomponents like lodging)
themes: FRED / BEA / BLS / Census API clients and curated macro panels (consumer sentiment, PCE services, CPI lodging, airfares, unemployment by metro)
why_all: Turnkey CPI deflator library with data actually committed to the repo rather than fetched live each time, useful for point-in-time-safe inflation adjustment of any nominal series in the model (ADR, GBV) without hitting BLS API rate limits.

name: bls (Python, OliverSherouse)
what_it_holds: Python client (GPL-2.0, dev branch 54 commits) wrapping the BLS API; get_series() pulls any BLS series ID with API-key-gated multi-decade history vs a default 3-year window with no key.
why_useful: Simple alternative BLS client for pulling CPI lodging/airfares/employment series programmatically and repeatably; marginal over what the team already has via FRED's BLS mirror, but useful if BLS-only series (not on FRED) are needed.
time_coverage: up to full BLS history with API key
themes: FRED / BEA / BLS / Census API clients and curated macro panels (consumer sentiment, PCE services, CPI lodging, airfares, unemployment by metro)
why_all: Simple alternative BLS client for pulling CPI lodging/airfares/employment series programmatically and repeatably; marginal over what the team already has via FRED's BLS mirror, but useful if BLS-only series (not on FRED) are needed.

name: tuik-forecasting-project
what_it_holds: Small repo forecasting Turkey's monthly Consumer Confidence Index using the `tuikr` R package (a client for TÜİK, Turkey's official statistics agency) to pull the series, then compares ten forecasting methods.
why_useful: Not useful for ABNB directly (Turkey is a small/non-priority geography for the pitch), but demonstrates a working R client (`tuikr`) for a non-US/EU official consumer-confidence series if the team ever needs EMEA-adjacent consumer data beyond Eurostat/OECD.
duplicate_of_holding: We already hold an OECD consumer confidence panel; Turkey specifically is not currently held but is low priority.
themes: Consumer sentiment and surveys: UMich, Conference Board, NY Fed SCE, EU consumer confidence, travel-intent surveys (Longwoods, Destination Analysts, MMGY) scraped
why_all: Not useful for ABNB directly (Turkey is a small/non-priority geography for the pitch), but demonstrates a working R client (`tuikr`) for a non-US/EU official consumer-confidence series if the team ever needs EMEA-adjacent consumer data beyond Eurostat/OECD.
